articles.summary: StockStory: Why Charter (CHTR) Stock Is Falling Today. Shares of cable, internet, and telephone services provider Charter (NASDAQ:CHTR) fell 3.8% in the afternoon session after Wells Fargo downgraded the stock, citing increasing competition and forecasting significant broadband subscriber losses.
